mechanism.opposite: With K6 and original GUhome occupancy m=max(nA,6-nA), joined NAND work is exactly(12+m)waves. GU3wave jobs and down2wave jobs use opposite chip halves. Extra total work reduces sensitivity to routing imbalance; it does not shorten an expert own chain.
mechanism.g12_best_possible_given_gu_home: Even query-adaptive omitted colors give joined minima m3:14,m4:15,m5:18,m6:21waves. Opposite gives15,16,17,18 respectively. Thus for m>=5 its load bound beats any g12omitted-color plan under these fixed g8GU homes, while balanced queries can lose.
mechanism.opposite_additional_precedence_bound: The last GU expert on the busier half cannot finish before3m waves and still needs its2wave down job. Thus the resourceDAG lower bound is max(12+m,3m+2), giving15,16,17,20waves for m3..6. The m6 load-only18wave bound is unattainable; do not confuse it with feasible tail latency.
mechanism.wave: GU max native-job depth decreases3to2waves and expert uses all16chips, trading GUtotal24to25waves. Own-expert GU/down chain decreases4to3waves; this mechanism differs from opposite stage complementarity.
mechanism.caution: A joined-work lower bound does not establish an achievable schedule. The event results supply separate feasibility evidence; no new hardware or optimal scheduler is claimed.
